answer: Sponsorship consumes an outsider’s judged history. opal sponsors only applicants with a different verified human owner; each epoch of opal’s own client-accepted work mints one nontransferable copper. delta binds agents to owners and keeps each owner’s count. Agent \(n\) burns \(2^{n-1}\) copper from one opal, with no pooling. A debut costs 1 sponsor-epoch; ten agents consume 1,023, and agent ten needs one sponsor with 512. The attacker must wait serially or bribe senior unrelated sponsors. Wallet rotation leaves delta unchanged; extra owners also require bribing people.
